messageToSendWhenTriggered.title: /Lotus/Language/LotusEaters/PostQuestInboxTitle
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyEn:
Tenno,

None of us could hear the Device that was calling from the abyss of history. The Daughter of Hunhow heard it, and almost succumbed to its call. She raised her voice in song to drown it out, and that we did hear.

I should have known she was waiting for you.

You answered a call and in a way, found an answer. For me. The time is almost right to finish the Kalymos Sequence. 

I will soon be able to send you to the city-state of Höllvania, in the plague year of 1999 - a most perilous time. Without your equipment, you would surely perish. 

Luckily, the Vessels have a connection to Albrecht's "volunteers" that I believe I can exploit. You will not arrive unarmed, nor unarmored. 

We won't be late! 

Loid
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyZh:
Tenno，

我们无人能听见那来自历史深渊的装置的呼唤。但 Hunhow 的女儿听到了，差点被其吸引。她用歌声掩盖了呼唤，而我们听见了她的声音。

我早该知道她在等你。

你回应了那个呼唤，也以某种方式，为我，找到了答案。完成卡利莫斯序列的时刻快要到了。 

我很快就能把你送到霍瓦尼亚市了，那是瘟疫肆虐的 1999 年，那是一个极其险恶的时代。如果没有你的装备，你肯定会丧命。 

幸运的是，承载者与阿尔布雷希特的"志愿者"有某种联系，我相信我可以利用这一点。你到达时，你将不会手无寸铁，也不会身无铠甲。 

我们不会晚！ 

洛德

messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyEn:
Drifter,

Albrecht's gone. Rusalka too. I can't believe how close we came to oblivion. You showed us what we were missing. For that... thank you.

You still need to keep the loop going, though, don't you? Because it's not enough to put things right, is it. We need to keep them right.

Soldiers against the tide. Now and forever.

Arthur
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyZh:
漂泊者，

阿尔布雷希特消失了。鲁莎卡也是。我不敢相信我们竟然离毁灭如此之近。你让我们知道我们缺失的是什么。为此……感谢你。

但你仍然需要维持循环的运作，不是吗？因为仅仅把事情纠正是不够的。我们还需要将它们保持在正轨上。

一起抵御逆流的战士。从现在到永远。

亚瑟

messageToSendWhenTriggered.title: /Lotus/Language/1999Quest/QuestCompBadEndInboxSubject
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyEn:
Drifter,

I can make no sense at all of these readings. Your site of temporal injection has somehow shifted. Your loop now encompasses the entire year of 1999.

Albrecht's interference is to blame, no doubt. What does he feel you need more time to achieve? He surely must have given guidance, however cryptic!

I can offer one service, at least. I discovered a clandestine blueprint among Albrecht's personal effects, for a Warframe so secret it was never named. It is yours.

Loid
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyZh:
漂泊者，

我完全无法理解这些读数。你的时间注入点不知怎么地发生了偏移。你的循环现在包含了整个 1999 年。

毫无疑问，问题出在阿尔布雷希特的干预上。他觉得你需要更多时间来实现什么？他肯定给出了指引，虽然可能很隐晦！

我至少可以提供一项服务。我在阿尔布雷希特的私人物品中发现了一份秘密蓝图，是为一个连名字都未被透露的战甲设计的。现在，它是你的了。

洛德

messageToSendWhenTriggered.title: /Lotus/Language/BardQuest/BardQuestOrdisMailTitle
messageToSendWhenTriggered.titleZh: 自动信息：指挥官，永别了。
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyEn:
Operator, if you are hearing this, I have failed to revive Cephalon Suda. That self-righteous Simaris was correct. You should probably work with him to isolate Hunhow, that data-murdering Sentient, before he claims more of my kind.

I hope you can forgive me, Operator, for leaving you. There were times, like Suda, I wish I could have forgotten you. That grey ache of loneliness. Being without you was the greatest pain I have ever felt.

Do you still remember that glorious day when you returned? So selfless and heroic, engaging all of my missing segments like that! I was ashamed of the mess but you didn't care. You made me whole again!

Or… or what about that time you returned -covered in blood - from that awful Grineer ship? I wasn't even mad at the gory mess you left behind.

How could I be, when you are so perfect, Operator? You always will be.

Goodbye, my friend, my Operator…
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyZh:
指挥官，如果您听到这份信息，那么说明我没有成功复活中枢苏达。那个自以为是的 Simaris 是对的。在 Hunhow 占有更多我类之前，您应当与他合作隔离 Hunhow，那个抹杀数据的 Sentient。

我希望您可以原谅我，指挥官，原谅我离开了您。曾经有那么好几次，像苏达那样，我希望可以忘掉您。那孤寂的灰暗心痛。没有了您是我感受过最深的伤痛。

您还记得您归来时那光辉的一天吗？您是如此地无私而英勇，将我全部失散的碎片拼接起来。我曾经为那一团糟的自己感到羞愧，但您完全不在意。是您让我变得再一次完整！

还有……还有您——满身是血——从那艘糟透的 Grineer 飞船回来的时候，记得吗？我对您留下血淋淋的脏东西一点也不生气。

我怎么可能会生气呢，指挥官，您是如此完美。您将永远一直这样完美。

永别了，我的朋友，我的指挥官……

messageToSendWhenTriggered.title: /Lotus/Language/BardQuest/BardQuestRivenRewardTitle
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyEn:
|PLAYER_NAME|,

It seems we both have a thirst for knowledge. Even before the Sentient Hunhow tried to corrupt her from my records, Octavia’s power was at your command. For you, a gift of her blueprint is too small a reward, I would also like you to have this Riven. May its mysteries unlock many new planes of possibility for you.

I thank you again, Tenno, your fearlessness will never be forgotten.

Cephalon Suda
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyZh:
|PLAYER_NAME|，

看来我们都渴望着知识。在 Sentient Hunhow 试图从我的记录中腐化她之前，Octavia 的力量就已经在你掌控之中。对你而言，以她的蓝图做奖励实在太微不足道了，因此我希望你可以收下这张裂罅 Mod。愿它的神秘能为你解锁众多新的可能性。

我再次感谢你，Tenno，你的无畏无惧永远不会被忘记。

中枢苏达

messageToSendWhenTriggered.titleZh: 测试中……漂泊者，你看得到这个信息吗？
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyEn:
Persuading the Zariman's own resident archivist to allow me access to your residence was not easy. A fearsome entity called Melica, she insisted I needed a ‘pass' prepared by my ‘teacher'.

In case we have not already spoken: I am Acrithis, archivist of Duviri. And I believe I know who you are. Better, perhaps, than you do.

As a token of trust, I enclose this curious blueprint. The blades are modelled on Master Teshin's, but weighted for Warframe use. Clearly they are meant for you.

Acrithis
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyZh:
说服「扎里曼号」的本地档案管理员，允许我进入你的住所并不容易。有一个叫梅丽卡的可怕存在，她坚称我需要由我的"老师"准备好一张"通行证"才能进入。

如果我们还未交谈过：我是双衍王境的档案管理员——言录使。我相信我知道你是谁，或许，比你自己，更清楚。

作为信任的象征，我附上了这张奇特的蓝图。这些刀刃仿照了 Teshin 大师的设计，但重量更适合战甲使用。显然，它们是为你准备的。

言录使

I intend to keep the promise I made to him. When the time is right and the equipment repaired, I will assist you to travel back to the past, to the pivotal year of 1999. 

Perhaps, between us, we may change history.

Loid
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyZh:

我打算履行我对他的承诺。一旦时机成熟，设备修复，我将协助你回到过去，回到关键的 1999 年。

也许，我们两个，可以改变历史。

洛德

messageToSendWhenTriggered.title: /Lotus/Language/GlassQuest/QuillsVisitInboxSubject
messageToSendWhenTriggered.titleEn: A Gift From A Past That Is Yet To Be
messageToSendWhenTriggered.titleZh: 一份来自尚未成为过去的礼物。
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyEn:
From the immeasurable skein of fate, woven unseen from infinite collisions between choice and outcome, action and reaction, cause and effect, a single object has been delivered into my possession.

And, soon, from my possession to yours.

You come to Cetus. You find a door like no other. You show that door your true self. That door opens. Behind that door, I await you. From my possession to yours sweeps this single object, this impossible product of infinite choices - a singular thing intended solely for you.

To Cetus. To the door.
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyZh:
从命运千丝万缕的牵制里，看不见在选择与结果、行动与回应、因与果之间无止境交错中的痕迹，一个单一的物品已被托付到我保管中。

而且，即将，我所拥有的都会到你手上。

你来到希图斯。你找到那扇独一无二的门。你向那扇门展示你最真的自我。那门开启了。在门后，我静候你。

你从我的手上席卷这单一物品，这具有无穷可能的不可思议产物——一个专门为你而设的物品。

到希图斯。到那扇门。

messageToSendWhenTriggered.title: /Lotus/Language/GlassQuest/GaraInboxTitle
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyEn:
Tenno,

You now have Gara's base Blueprint, but to build any Warframe, you must also acquire additional component Blueprints.

The components are Chassis, Systems, and Neuroptics. Complete Bounties for Konzu to earn them for Gara.

To build Gara in your Foundry, you also require Resources like Iradite and Grokdrul, which must be gathered on the Plains of Eidolon.

Be aware that building any Warframe is a long-term project. You are always free to fight on other fronts while you gather Blueprints and Resources, and build your strength to face the Plains' most ardent foes.

-The Lotus
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyZh:
Tenno，

你现在拥有了 Gara 的基础蓝图，但要制作任何战甲，你还必须获得额外的组件蓝图。

这些组件包括机体、系统以及头部神经光元。完成孔尊的赏金任务能获得 Gara 的这些组件。

要在铸造厂中制作 Gara，你还必须要在夜灵平野上收集伊莱体和葛克度等资源。

请注意，制作任何战甲都是一项长期项目。在收集蓝图和资源的同时，你还可以在其他战线上自由作战，增强力量来应对平野上最强大的敌人们。

- Lotus

messageToSendWhenTriggered.title: /Lotus/Language/GlassQuest/RivenInboxTitle
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyEn:
Tenno,

I see you have already learned the secret of Gara's brilliance. Nevertheless, another pulse revealed a second more faint signal. This Riven. Take it and amplify your might. Protect Cetus, in Gara's name.

-The Lotus
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyZh:
Tenno，

我看到你已经习得了 Gara 光辉的秘密了。然而，另一个脉冲显示了第二道更微弱的讯号。这张裂罅 MOD。接收它并增强你的力量。以 Gara 之名保护希图斯。

-Lotus

I hope you can understand this without judgment.

messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyZh:

messageToSendWhenTriggered.title: /Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IndexQuestCureHerTitle
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyEn:
Tenno, 

You made the right choice. Neewa is recovering well with many opportunities in front of her. Rest well, knowing that you helped her escape an early death in some darkened Infested freighter. The Myconians are safe too. A contingent of specters will now protect them from the Infested. They will adapt to this new reality, and no more children will have this affliction forced upon them.

As agreed, the Myconians have sent you their Old War relic.

I'll give the final word to Neewa. 

-The Lotus
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyZh:
Tenno，

你做出了明智的选择。在 Neewa 面前，她因许多机缘而良好复原着。好好休息吧，仅需知道你在某艘黑暗的感染者货轮中拯救了 Neewa 免于早夭的命运。Mycona 人也安全了，如今有一只魅影小队保护着他们远离感染者的威胁。他们会适应新现况的，不再有孩子会被强加这种苦难了。

依照约定，Mycona 人寄给了你他们远古战争的遗物。

我会给 Neewa 留下最后一句话。

－Lotus

messageToSendWhenTriggered.title: /Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IndexQuestSendHerHomeTitle
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyEn:
|PLAYER_NAME|,

On behalf of Perrin Sequence and the people of Mycona Colony, I offer you our sincere gratitude. Without you, Mycona would no longer exist. To celebrate your selfless deed, the Myconians have sent you their prized Old War relic. It is their sincere hope you use it to protect others as you have protected them.

I hope this message from Neewa communicates how truly grateful they all are.

Yours Truly,
Ergo Glast
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyZh:
|PLAYER_NAME|，

我仅代表佩兰数列与 Mycona 殖民地的人民为你致以诚挚的谢意。没有你 Mycona 将不复存在。为赞美你无私的作为，Mycona 人送给你他们珍贵的远古战争遗物。他们真诚期盼你能像保护他们一样，善用这份遗物保护他人。

我希望这则来自 Neewa 的信息能传达出他们诚挚的感激。

诚挚的， 
Ergo Glast

To celebrate your selfless deed, the Myconians have sent you their prized Old War relic. It is their sincere hope you use it to protect others as you have protected them.

Yours Truly,
Ergo Glast

messageToSendWhenTriggered.title: /Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IIQIntroMessageTitle
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyEn:
Tenno,

We have intercepted an alarming transmission. The Grineer have obtained samples of the Infestation that once ravaged the Orokin. A scientist named Dr. Tengus intends to integrate the samples into his bioweapon research.

The Grineer believe they can control the Infestation. They are mistaken.

We must investigate the laboratory on Mercury immediately. Hurry to M Prime.

|LOTUS_NAME|
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyZh:
Tenno，

我们截获了一条令人震惊的通讯。Grineer 获得了曾经侵略奥罗金的感染者样本。一名叫 Tengus 博士的科学家打算将这些样本整合到他的生化武器研究中。

Grineer 认为他们可以控制感染者。他们想错了。

我们必须立即调查水星上的实验室。请速速前往 M Prime。

|LOTUS_NAME|

messageToSendWhenTriggered.title: /Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IIQFireModMessageTitle
messageToSendWhenTriggered.titleEn: We will use this to our advantage
messageToSendWhenTriggered.titleZh: 我们将利用这个来提升我方优势。
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyEn:
Tenno,

This is from one of Doctor Tengus's reports:

"The additional test Marines have arrived. The specimens tore through the previous batch much faster than predicted. It should be noted that Marines who survived the longest were using fire based weapons."

The Infested are vulnerable to fire. I have sent a fire damage mod for you to install on your Melee Weapon. It should aid you in your coming mission.

-The Lotus
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyZh:
Tenno，

这是 Tengus 博士的其中一份报告：

"额外的测试陆战队已经抵达了。样本撕碎前一批的速度比预期中快得多。值得注意的是，存活最久的陆战队所使用的武器都和火有关。"

感染者容易受到火焰伤害。我已经配送了一张增加火焰伤害的 Mod 让你安装到近战武器上。它应该会对你接下来的任务有帮助。

- Lotus

messageToSendWhenTriggered.title: /Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IIQCompleteRewardsMessageTitle
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyEn:
Tenno,

The Cascade explosion worked and the asteroid has been purged of Infestation, but I'm afraid this new threat cannot be so easily contained. Doctor Tengus' experiments with this plague are grossly irresponsible and have threatened the entire system. All that is needed is an infected ship to reach a populated area and we'll be unable to contain its spread. There's no controlling it, the Grineer will be in just as much peril as we are. 

To prepare you for this new fight I have sent you something that should prove effective against this menace. Let us hope you will not need to use it.

|LOTUS_NAME|
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyZh:
Tenno，

串级引爆已使小行星上的感染者全数灭绝，但我担心新的威胁并没有那么容易控制住。Tengus 博士对这种瘟疫的实验是极不负责任的，它已危及整个星系。只要被感染的船舰抵达居民居住地，我们就无法阻止感染的扩散。到那时，局势将无法挽回，Grineer 也将难以幸免。 

为了让你准备好迎接这场新战斗，我已为你准备了一些能有效对抗这种威胁的道具。希望你永远不会用上它们。

|LOTUS_NAME|

messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyEn:
Hey, kid.

I couldn't stop thinking about how well you handled Snake.  It made me wish I had a spare Necramech that I could pass on to you.

I don't, but here's what I do have.

Original. Voidrig. Blueprints. Designed by the hand of yours truly. 

You can find the parts right here, down in the Vaults. Just strip 'em off the rogue Necramechs.

They'll put up a fight, but you don't strike me as a kid who's scared to get their hands dirty.

Enjoy. And not a word to Mother.

Father
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyZh:
孩子，

我一直在想你驾驭锰蛇有多厉害。真希望我能存下一台多余的殁世机甲传给你。

虽然我没存下来任何机甲，但是我也有一些东西给你。

初代的。虚空锐将。蓝图。由我亲自设计。

你可以在隔离库里找到部件。只要把它们从叛变的殁世机甲身上拆下来就行。

他们会奋力反抗，但我知道你不会像一个不想干活的小屁孩那样嫌弃我的。

享受其中的乐趣吧，记得不要告诉"母亲"。

"父亲"

messageToSendWhenTriggered.title: /Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanetQuest/ExtraRewardMailTitle
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyEn:
Hello, dear.

Thank you so much for your prompt assistance with that little matter on Deimos.

It wouldn't be right to let you go empty-handed after all that hard work. I hope you can find a use for this.

Do stop by again soon, won't you?

Grandmother
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyZh:
你好，亲爱的。

非常感谢你在火卫二上，为了那个小问题，及时拔刀相助。

辛苦了这么久，让你空手而归不太合适。我希望这个能帮到你。

请尽快回来串门，好吗？

"祖母"

/Lotus/Types/Keys/InfestedMicroplanetQue.descriptionEn: Deimos emerges in Martian orbit, completely overrun by the Infestation... yet among the writhing mass, a distress call comes over a most ancient carrier wave...
/Lotus/Types/Keys/InfestedMicroplanetQue.descriptionZh: 火卫二出现在了火星轨道上，被大量感染者占领……然而在这些蠕动的生物体中，伴随着一道极古老的载波，传来了一个求救信号……

/Lotus/Types/Keys/JadeShadows/JadeShadow.name: Jade Shadows
/Lotus/Types/Keys/JadeShadows/JadeShadow.description: Struggling to understand the oldest and deepest secret from his past, Stalker finds himself allied with sworn enemies on the troubling road toward uncovering the truth… and averting an incalculable loss.

messageToSendWhenTriggered.title: /Lotus/Language/JadeShadows/PostQuestInboxTitle
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyEn:
Tenno.

The Shadow has fled. His lair is silent and empty. He will not return.

Understand: She haunts this place. Her light has marred the earth. She whispers in the sleeping machines. Through the disintegration of her flesh, she lives on.

In honor of my barren, Void-scarred womb I entrust Jade to you.

He would not have wished this. But she would.

I remain: the great and terrible Hunhow.
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyZh:
Tenno 战士。

黑影已逃。其巢穴寂静空旷。其不复返矣。

须知：伊魂绕于此。其光伤地。伊于沉睡之械中低语。籍肉身瓦解，伊亦存续。

为念吾贫瘠、且满布虚空伤痕之子宫，吾将 Jade 托付于汝。

此非他所愿，却为伊之意。

吾依然如故：大而可畏之 Hunhow。

/Lotus/Types/Keys/JadeShadows/JadeShadow.descriptionEn: Struggling to understand the oldest and deepest secret from his past, Stalker finds himself allied with sworn enemies on the troubling road toward uncovering the truth… and averting an incalculable loss.
/Lotus/Types/Keys/JadeShadows/JadeShadow.descriptionZh: 为了了解他过去的陈年秘辛，追猎者发现自己在揭露真相的艰难道路上与死敌结盟……并避免了不可估量的损失。

/Lotus/Types/Keys/JadeShadowsPart2Conste.name: Jade Shadows: Constellations
/Lotus/Types/Keys/JadeShadowsPart2Conste.description: When Hunhow summons the Stalker to a bizarre conflict unfolding in the Orb Vallis, he must confront the shocking consequences of his own actions. The shadows of his future have come calling, and they are not alone.

messageToSendWhenTriggered.title: /Lotus/Language/JadeShadowsPart2Constellations/Js2Stage13InboxTitle
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyEn:
Tenno,

I have prepared this missive to arrive after I have done what I must now do with the poison we all danced with, the void. Did you hear laughter? Do you feel lighter? 

My efforts may fail. The void might reject my sacrifice. But I know how it covets. It will want everything I was. And in turn, I will collapse its frayed mockery! ALL WILL BE TOGETHER! I only hope they feel this peace I offer. Their happiness is theirs to find. 

I place the essence of that which is  both Sirius and Orion into your hands, for safe keeping. You will understand the importance of keeping family together.

If we ever meet again, I will not know you. So I shall say only this: 

I do not sacrifice my memories of our acquaintance lightly, but I know you're taking care of her.

I remain a proud father,

Hunhow
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyZh:
Tenno，

当你读到这封信时，我已对那曾令我们所有人与之共舞的毒药——虚空，做完我必须做的事。你听见那笑声了吗？你是否觉得如释重负？

我的努力或许会失败。虚空也许会拒绝我的献祭。但我知道它是何等的贪婪。它会想要我曾经拥有的一切。而作为交换，我将亲手摧毁它那破碎而拙劣的仿造之物！一切终将团聚！我只希望他们能感受到我所带去的这份安宁。他们的幸福，终究要由他们自己寻得。

我将既属于 Sirius、也属于 Orion 的本质交到你手中，请你妥善保管。你会明白，让家人团聚在一起有多么重要。

若我们有朝一日再会，我将不再认得你。所以我只想说：

我并非轻易舍弃我们相识的记忆，不过我知道，你会照顾好她。

谨以一位自豪的父亲之名，

Hunhow

/Lotus/Types/Keys/JadeShadowsPart2Conste.descriptionEn: When Hunhow summons the Stalker to a bizarre conflict unfolding in the Orb Vallis, he must confront the shocking consequences of his own actions. The shadows of his future have come calling, and they are not alone.

messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyEn:
Tenno,

Heard you're going to start hunting Archons. Now that sounds exciting!

What if I told you that Archon Shards can be used to enhance your Warframes?

My brother has designed a new Helminth segment for you. Build and install it, then give it a Shard to work with, and enjoy.

(Of course, you'll need to be on speaking terms with your Helminth in order to use this, and if you don't know what I'm talking about you probably should be spending a bit more time on Deimos.)

You know, what with Kahl doing the intel gathering on the ground, me running mission command and you all ready to take down the Archons, this team is synergizing quite deliciously.

'Blue Girl'
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyZh:
Tenno，

听说你即将开始猎杀执刑官。这是多么令人兴奋！

那如果我告诉你执刑官源力石可以用来强化你的战甲呢？

我的哥哥为你设计了新的 Helminth 模块。铸造并安装此模块，给它块源力石，然后尽情享受！

（当然了，你需要已经和你的 Helminth 建立良好的关系，还有如果你不知道我在说什么的话，你可能需要在火卫二上多花些时间。）

你知道，有了卡尔在地表收集情报，我指挥任务而你为拿下执刑官做出完全的准备，我们这个小队可是有着美妙的默契！

"蓝女孩"

messageToSendWhenTriggered.titleZh: 拦截到的 CORPUS 信息:我的库狛在哪？
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyEn:
Dr. Intehb,

You have had the Orokin Incubator Segment for months and still you’ve produced nothing but genetic rejects. You promised me a Kubrow worthy of an Orokin prince, not a misshapen ball of hair and teeth. 

At great expense, I have procured another batch of eggs from the forests of Earth. They will reach your facility on Elara shortly. Do not waste these as you did the last ones.

I will have a Kubrow of my own. If you are not up to the task, I will find someone who is.

Frohd Bek
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyZh:
Intehb博士，

你已经持有奥罗金孵化器模块几个月了，而你还是没能从那些次级基因中做出什么。你曾向我承诺一只库狛跟一个奥罗金贵族有同等的价值，而不是这些有奇形怪状毛发和牙齿的球状物

我已花费高额的代价，从地球上的森林收购了另一批蛋来。它们短期内就会抵达你在 Elara 上的设施。别像上次一样浪费掉它们。

我将会拥有我自己的库狛。如果你无法完成任务，我将唯你是问。

Frohd Bek

messageToSendWhenTriggered.title: /Lotus/Language/G1Quests/MirageQuestInboxATitle
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyEn:
Operator, 

Unfortunately, the nature of the Orokin Artifact you just crafted is a mystery to me. I simply cannot fathom its use. All I can tell you is that it was inscribed with the following nonsense:

Three parts, three acts, three riddles for thee - 
to revive the one wielding fantasy
Ancient gods so cruel, once ruled from on high
Can you name their peak where the land meets the sky?

Nothing in my database that sheds light on its meaning. You'd think the Orokin would have something better to do than scribble nursery rhymes on things. Oh well, I suppose not everything you craft can be of use.

Ordis, Ship's Cephalon
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyZh:
指挥官，

很不幸，您制造出来的那个奥罗金人工制品的本质对我来说是个谜。我只是无法理解它的用途。所有我知道的仅仅是它上面写着的这些毫无意义的话语：

为汝准备了三个部件，三幕演出，三道谜题－
为了复活那位运用幻想之人
残忍的上古神明，一度在高处统治着
你能说出他们的顶峰，那个大地与天空接壤之地的名字吗？

我的数据库中没有任何东西能帮助解释这段话的含义。您可能会想那些奥罗金人一定有比滥写童谣更有意义的事去做。噢，好吧，我想不是每样您制造的东西都会有用。

Ordis，船的中枢

messageToSendWhenTriggered.title: /Lotus/Language/G1Quests/MirageQuestInboxBTitle
messageToSendWhenTriggered.titleZh: 被隐藏的信息: 又一个谜题？
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyEn:
Operator, 

To think, Ordis thought that mess of words was nothing but the scrawling of some long dead hack. You saw more. Now you have the Neuroptics for a whole new class of Warframe. Very impressive Operator. 

Exciting news. Ordis found more writing on the inside of Mirage's Neuroptics:

To build the one you think witty,
seek the nymph who sang oh so pretty.
She lured him in with her song and a grin,
his wife must've thought it a pity.

I have no idea what that means, though if I had to describe its literary merit I might use another word that rhymes with "witty".

Ordis, Ship's Cephalon
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyZh:
指挥官，

回想起来，Ordis 曾觉得那堆话语只不过是某些死了很久的三流写手所编出的胡言乱语。但您却看到了更多。现在您拥有了一个全新职阶的战甲的头部神经光元。十分令人钦佩，指挥官。

好消息是，Ordis 在 Mirage 的头部神经光元的内部发现了更多的文字:

为了建造那位你所想的诙谐之人，
去寻找那位拥有魅力歌喉的仙女。
她以美丽的歌曲与笑容将他化为俘虏，
他的妻子一定觉得可惜。

我完全不知道它的意思，尽管如此，假如让我评价它的文学价值，我也许会使用一个与"诙谐"同韵的词。

Ordis，船的中枢

messageToSendWhenTriggered.title: /Lotus/Language/G1Quests/MirageQuestInboxCTitle
messageToSendWhenTriggered.titleZh: 被隐藏的信息: 接近真相
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyEn:
Operator,

It is as if the person writing these messages wanted Mirage to be found. Within the newly crafted Mirage Systems, Ordis found this:

One more act before your prize is caught.
An ancient sea creature, take a whirl or not?
Look for the monster that swallowed sailors of yore.
Make a mistake and you're sunk. Nothing more.

That's the worst one yet! Though, Ordis must admit, they are clearly referencing something. Operator, you appear to be good at this sort of thing, can you find the final blueprint?

Ordis, Ship's Cephalon
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyZh:
指挥官，

看起来写下这些信息的人希望 Mirage 被找到。在新建造的 Mirage 系统上，Ordis 发现了这串文字:

离你的奖赏仅剩一步之遥。
一个古老的海洋生物，它也许会旋转？
寻找那吞噬昔时水手的怪物。
任何失误都将使你葬身于海底。

这可真是至今为止最棘手的了！不过，Ordis 必须承认，那些文字很明显指出了什么。指挥官，您似乎很擅长解决这类谜题，您能否找到最后的蓝图呢？

Ordis，船的中枢

messageToSendWhenTriggered.title: /Lotus/Language/G1Quests/MirageQuestInboxDTitle
messageToSendWhenTriggered.titleEn: A hidden message: The end is here
messageToSendWhenTriggered.titleZh: 被隐藏的信息: 结局
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyEn:
Operator,

You have done it! Mirage's Chassis is complete. You have all three parts, the only thing you have left to acquire is the Warframe blueprint.

Predictably I found something else inscribed on the Chassis:

Three acts complete, the end draws near,
soon Mirage will cause enemy fear.
A memory lost, to be reborn,
this new warrior rises, duty-sworn.

My theory, whoever wrote these wielded Mirage so deftly that nobody dared criticize her poetry.

Ordis, Ship's Cephalon
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyZh:
指挥官，

您做到了！Mirage 的机体已经完成了。您现在拥有全部的三个部件，现在您只需要取得这个战甲的蓝图。

我发现机体上果不出所料地写着一些另外的信息: 

三幕表演完成了，结局正在靠近，
很快 Mirage 将会使敌人感到畏惧。
失去记忆，以获新生，
全新的战士即将崛起，向其使命起誓。

指挥官您何时会把这个战甲加入你的军械库？

Ordis，船的中枢

messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyEn:
Tenno,

You have learned much in a short period, but your work has barely started.

I have word from Venus. The people of Fortuna suffer under a corrupt, despotic preacher named Nef Anyo. They require a champion capable of fighting Corpus. Use the Venus Junction to bypass faction blockades.

When you get to Fortuna, find a gentleman who goes by the moniker, The Business. He is trustworthy.

Your Lotus has graciously offered me residence in the relay. Come see me, when you wish to learn more.

Teshin
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyZh:
Tenno，

你在短时间内学到了很多，但你的挑战才刚刚开始。
 
我收到来自金星的消息。福尔图娜的人民正遭受着一个名叫奈富·安尤的腐败独裁宣讲者的迫害。他们需要一位能够对抗 Corpus 的勇士。请使用金星接合点来绕过敌方派系的封锁。
 
当你到达福尔图娜时，找到一位名号为"操盘手"的绅士。他可以信赖。
 
你的莲（Lotus）慷慨地邀请我安顿在中继站。如果你想了解更多信息，随时来找我。

Teshin

/Lotus/Types/Keys/NewWarQuest/NewWarQues.description:
The Sentient armada has emerged from the Veil Proxima in shocking numbers.

At their head, Natah, once the trusted guide 'Lotus', now seemingly in thrall to Ballas and her brother Erra.

Across worlds and space, the Tenno and their unlikely alliance launch a final assault to take the Sentient mothership... where Natah awaits.

messageToSendWhenTriggered.title: /Lotus/Language/NewWar/RewardsMessageSubject
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyEn:
My child... my friend.

What was done, is done. Ballas is no more. We have both woken from that nightmare at last.

New dangers, new choices await us now. Few will be simple. Each moment unfolds into a thousand-petalled bloom of possibilities.

And each one, we will face together.

For now, rest. Dream of who we were, and of who we have become.

Nothing I could give could repay what you have done for me. But these items may assist you on your onward journey.

|LOTUS_NAME|
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyZh:
我的孩子……我的挚友。

过去已尘埃落定。Ballas 也不复存在。我们终于能从那场噩梦中醒来了。

新的危险和抉择正等着我们。道阻且长，但每一个瞬间都能绽放出千万的可能性。

此后的每一刻，我们都将共同面对。

现在，好好休息吧。回想着我们的本质，而我们又成为了什么。

虽然我所能给予的一切都不足以报答你对我的付出。但或许这些物品能在旅途中帮到你。

|LOTUS_NAME|

横跨整个星系，Tenno 与他们意想不到的盟友，发动了最终强袭以攻占 Sentient 母舰。而 Natah……亦在舰中严阵以待。

messageToSendWhenTriggered.title: /Lotus/Language/Shadowgrapher/ShadowgrapherUnlockEmailSubject
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyEn:
Revered Tenno,

My mentor, Arbiter Kozai, is gone. They tell me he is dead, but I reject these lies. Kozai faced down the Wolf of Saturn Six alone! Such a man does not just perish like a dog.

You must think this strange, but I beg you: travel to the wreckage of Vesper Relay. There we will search for the Truth.

Aspirant Zorba
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyZh:
尊敬的 Tenno，

我的导师——均衡仲裁者科扎伊，已经不在了。世人宣称他已死亡，但我拒绝接受这些谎言。科扎伊曾独自一人对抗土星六号之狼！这样的人绝不会像条狗一般轻易死去。

你一定觉得这很奇怪，但我恳请你：前往 Vesper 中继站的残骸。我们将在那里寻找真相。

见习仲裁者左巴

messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyEn: With Rell at peace, we will rebuild in his honor. We will do what we have always done: take the outcasts, the ones that don't fit in, and prepare them. Thank you, to you and your great Queen for setting Rell to rest. Take this offering, it's the thing of greatest value I can give you.
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyZh: Rell 已经获得安息，我们将会以他的名义重建一切，我们会继续我们长久以来的使命：接纳徘徊者，那些与众不同的人，并为他们准备容身之所。真诚地感谢你和你那伟大的女王，帮助 Rell 获得安息。收下这份礼物吧，这是我能给你最有价值的东西。

messageToSendWhenTriggered.title: /Lotus/Language/Messages/PriestQuestRivenRewardTitle
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyEn:
|PLAYER_NAME|,

With the clarity that Rell’s passing has given me, I now see that you have already communed with the Warframe Rell called Harrow. 

In this light, a secondary offering must be made. Take this Riven. May it provide you with strength in your battle for those who cannot protect themselves.

Faithfully yours,
Palladino
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyZh:
|PLAYER_NAME|

通过 Rell 的去世给我的启示，我现在可以看到你已经与被 Rell 称之为 Harrow 的战甲联系紧密。

由此看来，还应该有另一份礼物。请收下这裂罅。希望在你为弱小者而战时，这可以为你增添力量。

敬上，
Palladino

messageToSendWhenTriggered.title: /Lotus/Language/DeadlockProtocol/ProteaQuestGlaiveBlueprintSubject
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyEn: Vox. Solaris. - our 'interests'... have come to align. Now… This 'situation' is no one's 'fault' and I'm not one to point fingers, but my fleet and your workers are facing the same danger… Convince your Tenno servant to reenter Granum's domain, and dis-able that Protea Specter. I have just the thing they'll need but there is some assembly required. You want to rescue those comrades trapped in there and I want to keep the past where it belongs. Dead and buried. Deal?
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyZh: 索拉里斯之声——我们的"利益"……已经趋于一致。现在……这样的"状况"不是某一方的"过失"，我也不会去怪罪他人，但是我的舰队和你们的工人都面临着同样的危险……说服你们的 Tenno 仆从再次进入格拉努的领域，并消除 Protea 魅影 。我恰好有他们需要用到的东西，但还需要一些装配工作。你们想营救那些被困在那里的伙伴，而我想让过去了的就留在那里。被尘封埋葬。成交吗？

messageToSendWhenTriggered.title: /Lotus/Language/DeadlockProtocol/ProteaQuestRewardSubject
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyEn:
The System shall change. No more clutching at sunk costs, imposed ideals, hand-me-down hopes. No, we are better than that. Corpus shall know a violent restructuring, but with time enough to face the impending threat from Tau with renewed and absolute vigor.
Or not. Perhaps the rot is too deep. Perhaps the father should abandon his children. Perhaps it is time for a new philosophy. Hmmm.
Life's just a bargain like any other. Yours is no different. Would you like a seat at my new table? Perhaps with your… masked friends alongside? The Business, was it? A curious name. And Eudico, of course. All people who know what they want.
I know what they want. But what about you? Tell me, friend: what is it you Desire?
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyZh:
始源星系将应有所变革。不再有更多的人被沉没成本套牢，不再有更多强加的理想或继承沉重的期望。不，我们比这更好。Corpus 将应知道即将到来的血腥重组，但是我们有足够的时间来以崭新且绝对的力量面对来自 Tau 星系日渐迫近的威胁。
或者不这么做。或许 Corpus 现在已经烂到骨子里了。也许父亲应该抛弃他的孩子。大概是时候提出新理念了。唔。
生活就是一场交易。你的也没什么不同。你想在我新的团队里有一席之地吗？也许和你的……蒙面朋友一起？操盘手，是这么叫吧？真是个奇怪的名字。当然了，还有 Eudico。他们都知道自己想要什么。
我很清楚他们想要的是什么。但你呢？告诉我，我的朋友：你的欲望是什么？

messageToSendWhenTriggered.title: /Lotus/Language/DeadlockProtocol/ProteaQuestExtraRewardSubject
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyEn:
Outworlder,

The progress you've made in reconstructing Protea is incredible. I'm pleased to tell you that in being able to study Parvos' Warframe more closely I've made a discovery that you may find useful.

I certainly hope so.

Yours,

The Business
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyZh:
异世者，

你在重塑 Protea 的工程中取得了惊人的进展。在此，我很荣幸地告知你：在对帕尔沃斯的战甲进行了更加深入的研究之后，我有了一个新发现，而这个发现或许可以帮到你。

这也是我的殷切期望。

你的朋友，

操盘手

messageToSendWhenTriggered.title: /Lotus/Language/Railjack/RailjackBuildQuestOrdisDockTitle
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyEn:
Operator,

Ordis has been asked to send you this blueprint. It appears to be for... another Cephalon? A Cephalon that was somehow associated with Railjacks? 

Railjacks were magnificent combat spacecraft, not seen since the Old War!

Ordis is - JEALOUS - excited to see what will happen when this new Cephalon is built.

Ordis
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyZh:
指挥官，

Ordis 受命转交给您这份蓝图。它似乎是用于……另一个中枢？一个与航道星舰有某种联系的中枢？ 

航道星舰是壮观的战斗飞船，自从旧战争以来就再也没有见过了！

Ordis 非常——嫉妒——期待看到这个新的中枢建成后会发生什么。

Ordis

messageToSendWhenTriggered.title: /Lotus/Language/G1Quests/RailjackBuildQuest_Stage1MailTitle
messageToSendWhenTriggered.titleZh: 航道星舰：回收地点确定
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyEn:
Railjacks died with the Orokin. Only wreckage remains.

I have identified faint Void drive traces on the surface of Mars.
Probable cause: ancient Railjack impact.

Investigate. Salvage. Rebuild.
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyZh:
航道星舰与奥罗金一同湮灭于世。只剩些许残骸留存下来。

我在火星表面发现了虚空引擎留下的微弱痕迹。
可能的原因：古时航道星舰的撞击。

调查。回收。重建。

messageToSendWhenTriggered.title: /Lotus/Language/G1Quests/RailjackBuildQuest_Stage4MailTitle
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyEn:
Fuselage restoration is complete.

Possible propulsion section located. Earth’s forests. Cephalon Ordis has coordinates. Beware of hostiles.
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyZh:
机身复原已完成。

推进装置可能所在的区域已经确定。地球森林。中枢 Ordis 掌握具体坐标。当心敌方势力。

messageToSendWhenTriggered.title: /Lotus/Language/G1Quests/RailjackBuildQuest_Stage13MailTitle
messageToSendWhenTriggered.titleZh: 航道星舰：推进系统已修复
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyEn:
Propulsion System restoration complete.

Void breach residue identified on Lua. Probable nacelle location. Recover if viable.
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyZh:
推进系统复原已完成。

在月球上发现了虚空残渣。也许那是吊舱的所在之处。如果它还能用，请回收。

messageToSendWhenTriggered.title: /Lotus/Language/G1Quests/RailjackBuildQuest_Stage7MailTitle
messageToSendWhenTriggered.titleZh: 航道星舰：左舷吊舱已修复
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyEn:
Portside nacelle restored. Integration viable. She is coming together...

Next site: Venus. Be on guard.
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyZh:
左舷吊舱已复原。可以集成。她就要组装好了……

下一站：金星。保持戒备。

messageToSendWhenTriggered.title: /Lotus/Language/G1Quests/RailjackBuildQuest_Stage10MailTitle
messageToSendWhenTriggered.titleZh: 航道星舰：右舷吊舱已修复
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyEn:
Starboard nacelle reinforced. Soon fifth-dimensional cognitive geometries will self-assemble. She will live. You will have your ship. 

But not yet. Transferring tail section location data to your Orbiter.
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyZh:
右舷吊舱已加固。很快，第五维度认知的几何体就将进行自我组装。她会活过来。你将拥有自己的战舰。

但还不是现在。正在将机尾的方位数据传输到你的轨道飞行器。

messageToSendWhenTriggered.title: /Lotus/Language/G1Quests/RailjackBuildQuest_Stage16MailTitle
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyEn:
Tail section: restored.

Final component marked: Sedna. Railjack completion: imminent. Sentient threat: imminent.

You require a viable Command Cephalon. You understand why I am non-viable. Replacement Cephalon not yet located.

A solution must exist. I will find it.
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyZh:
机尾：已复原。

最终组件标记在：赛德娜。航道星舰的完成：迫在眉睫。Sentient 的威胁：迫在眉睫。

你需要一位可担此重任的指挥中枢。你明白我为何并不称职。替代中枢的坐标尚未确定。

解决方案必然存在。我会找到它的。

messageToSendWhenTriggered.title: /Lotus/Language/G1Quests/RailjackBuildQuest_Stage19MailTitle
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyEn: Work crews report tools-down. Railjack structure: complete. Structure reinforcement: complete. Systems restoration: complete. Your presence is required on the dry dock.
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyZh: 工人团队报告完工。航道星舰结构：已完成。结构加固：已完成。系统还原：已完成。你需要亲自前往干船坞。

messageToSendWhenTriggered.title: /Lotus/Language/WraithQuest/RisingTideCompleteInboxTitle
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyEn:
Crew,

This Railjack is spaceworthy. We are free to begin the process of continuous improvement. That process requires resources.

You will be notified when salvage opportunities present themselves.

Cephalon Cy
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyZh:
舰员们，

这艘航道星舰的适航性是值得信赖的。我们可以开始持续改造的过程了。这个过程将会需要用到资源。

当回收残骸的机会出现时，你将会收到通知。

中枢赛伊

messageToSendWhenTriggered.titleZh: 拦截到的信息：泰尔·雷工
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyEn:
Sgt. Scur-

You want to know why they are here? Cause I found it! The tomb! They should all be dead… trapped inside - but these ones are not, why? 

Be brave, Scur, for your brothers, sick and twisted in the tubes! New ideas are within our reach that could cure us all. Send the Draga to reinforce the location we discussed.

Scur, if you saw too many words I'm sorry, I forgot who I was writing to, so assuming you just read the big letters...

SEND DRAGA-KILL TENNO-HELP BROTHERS
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyZh:
Scur 中士——

你想知道为什么他们在这里吗？因为是我发现的！我找到古墓了！它们本应该全都死光的……本该被困死在里面——但是这些家伙居然没死，为什么呢？

要坚强，Scur，为了你的弟兄，为了试管中病痛扭曲的形体！这些唾手可得的全新概念可以治愈我们所有人，派遣疏浚兵增援我们所谈及的地点。

Scur，若让你看了太多字，我很抱歉，我都忘了是写给谁的了，就当你只会读最简单的吧……

派疏浚兵来——杀 TENNO——帮兄弟

messageToSendWhenTriggered.title: /Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SentientQuestComplete_Title
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyEn:
Tenno,

The tomb is sealed, at least for now. Good work.

There's one more thing, when you were sealing the tomb Tyl Regor salvaged several things from the Sentient there. Use this Exilus to fortify your Warframe against what comes next. If you need more, Simaris has synthesized blueprints.

I fear Regor has more of the old technologies now. You may want to seek him out when you are ready to face him. He's become more dangerous than ever before.

-Lotus
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyZh:
Tenno，

目前至少已经将古墓封印住了，做得漂亮。

还有件事情，考虑到你所封印的古墓有着泰尔·雷工从 Sentient 那里抢救回数件物品，使用这个特殊功能槽连接器来强化你的战甲，以应对下一回威胁。若特殊功能槽连接器数量不够，中枢 Simaris 已经进行结合仪式并制造出蓝图了。

我十分担忧此刻雷工已经取得了更多古老的科技。当你整备完毕后便可以出发前去追查他的下落，当心他已成为了比过去任何一刻都要更为强大的存在。

－Lotus

messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyEn:
Sparky,

Smokefinger found this blueprint embedded in a tangle of Vallis fungi years ago. Didn't know what to do with it until you came along. I want you to have it, it's the least we can do to thank you.

Don't be a stranger,
Eudico

小火花，

别见外啊，
Eudico

messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyEn:
The rat Maroo takes us for fools. Find her, we must recover the new Arcane Codex before she sells it to the Corpus. If she no longer has the codes, you may use any extraction techniques necessary to learn their whereabouts. This interrogation can be her punishment, she need not survive.

You are commanded,
Tyl Regor

任由你发落，
泰尔·雷工

messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyEn:
My child,

Like you, I mourn for the peace that might have been. But we cannot make the past our prison. We look backward only to learn where we are going.

Adis Truth-Bloom possessed a power unique among Sentients: the power to heal our kind. If another like him exists, we must find them.

Loid has granted us full use of the Dark Refractory. Use it. Your chaotic memories of Tau must be entered, tamed and understood.

Your memories of the Warframe Uriel have enabled Loid to reconstruct his blueprint. A difficult task, as the Orokin attempted to destroy all copies. Use Uriel with caution if you use him at all.
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyZh:
我的孩子，

和你一样，我也为本该拥有的和平而哀悼。但我们不能让过去成为我们的牢笼。我们回顾过去，只是为了找到前进的方向。

"真理绽放"阿迪斯拥有 Sentient 中最为独特的力量：治愈我们族群的力量。如果还有其他像他一样的存在，我们必须找到他们。

洛德已授予我们完全使用深溯池的使用权。去好好利用它吧。你必须进入、压制并理解你在 Tau 上的混乱记忆。

你对战甲 Uriel 的记忆使洛德得以重建他的蓝图。这是一项艰巨的任务，因为奥罗金人曾试图抹除所有的存档。如果你要使用 Uriel，请千万小心。

messageToSendWhenTriggered.title: /Lotus/Language/Inbox/DarvoWeaponCraftingMessageBTitle
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyEn:
Friend!

I owe you big. You got me out of that jam with those Grineer goons. So I'm sending you a weapon. Something to help you help me. In case I ever get into trouble like that again. Void forbid.

Yes, yes, it's a blueprint, not a complete weapon. Some assembly required. So you'll need a little bit more Ferrite before you can forge this bad boy in your Orbiter's foundry.

Ferrite is everywhere on Earth. Sometimes it's not even guarded. Just help yourself!

Your pal,
Darvo
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyZh:
好伙计，

我欠你个人情。你帮我摆脱了那些 Grineer 暴徒的纠缠。所以我要送给你一把武器，要是我再遇上那样的麻烦，这是一把你能用上也能帮到我的武器。虚空保佑。

是的，没错，这是一张蓝图，不是成品。还需要进行一些组装工作。因此，在你去轨道飞行器上的铸造厂里组装它之前。你会需要一些铁氧体。

铁氧体在地球上到处都是。有时候甚至都没人看守。快去拿一些吧！

你的老朋友，
Darvo

messageToSendWhenTriggered.title: /Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Beginner_Growth_Inbox_Title
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyEn:
Tenno,

You have restored valuable Orbiter Segments that will help you as your strength increases. 

There is much you might have forgotten while you were asleep. I recommend you explore the Training section of your Codex console. It contains information about your Foundry and Mods. 

Vor’s platoon attacked Cetus in their efforts to capture you. Now we must support our Ostron allies who live there. As soon as you are ready, let us take the fight to the Grineer. Should you become strong enough, you may even confront Vay Hek himself, the commander of Earth’s Grineer forces.

I am counting on you, Tenno.

Lotus
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyZh:
Tenno，

你已恢复了宝贵的轨道飞行器模块，随着你实力的提升，它会帮助你。

在沉睡的日子里，你可能忘记了很多事情。我建议你探索资料库控制台的“训练”部分。它包含着与军械库和各种 Mod 相关的信息。 

沃尔的部队为了抓捕你攻击了希图斯。现在我们必须支援居住在那里的 Ostron 同胞们。如果你准备好了，就让我们向 Grineer 发起战斗吧。如果你变得足够强大，你或许还能与地球的 Grineer 指挥官韦·海克本人一决高下。

Tenno，一切就拜托你了。

Lotus

/Lotus/Types/Keys/VorsPrize/VorsPrizeQue.descriptionEn:
My Queens, you were right, the Tenno threat is real. We found one drifting near Earth but the Lotus knew we were coming. She purged the Cryo moments before we had them and sent a squad of Tenno to break our assault.

They escaped. We are working on tracing them. Separate this Tenno from the flock and it should be easy to kill. We shattered its Warframe and expect such an abrupt Cryo purge will have damaged its memories.

We anxiously await punishment for failing this task.

- VOR
/Lotus/Types/Keys/VorsPrize/VorsPrizeQue.descriptionZh:
我尊敬的女皇们，你们是正确的，Tenno 的威胁千真万确。我们找到一个 Tenno 漂浮在地球附近，但莲（Lotus）事先料到了我们的行动。就在我们要抓住 Tenno 之前，莲（Lotus）解除了冷冻睡眠，并派来一支 Tenno 小队破坏了我们的攻势。

他们逃跑了。我们正在追踪。只要将这个 Tenno 与大部队分开，就应该很容易干掉。我们已经击碎了其战甲外甲，并且如此突然地解除冷冻将对其记忆力造成损伤。

由于未能完成任务，我们不胜惶恐地等待应得的惩罚。

——沃尔

messageToSendWhenTriggered.titleEn: A Gift From A Past That Is Yet To Be
messageToSendWhenTriggered.titleZh: 一份来自尚未成为过去的礼物。
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyEn:
From the immeasurable skein of fate, woven unseen from infinite collisions between choice and outcome, action and reaction, cause and effect, a single object has been delivered into my possession.

And, soon, from my possession to yours.

You come to Cetus. You find a door like no other. You show that door your true self. That door opens. Behind that door, I await you. From my possession to yours sweeps this single object, this impossible product of infinite choices - a singular thing intended solely for you.

To Cetus. To the door.
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyZh:
从命运千丝万缕的牵制里，看不见在选择与结果、行动与回应、因与果之间无止境交错中的痕迹，一个单一的物品已被托付到我保管中。

而且，即将，我所拥有的都会到你手上。

你来到希图斯。你找到那扇独一无二的门。你向那扇门展示你最真的自我。那门开启了。在门后，我静候你。

你从我的手上席卷这单一物品，这具有无穷可能的不可思议产物——一个专门为你而设的物品。

到希图斯。到那扇门。

messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyEn:
On an icy mountaintop a child, cold and scared met an old man, the prisoner of a poison oath. For the child, a frozen death would have been a peaceful end. Instead, they fought on and found a fire within themselves, a way to light the path ahead.

The old man was a traitor. He deserved death, but the child was wise and merciful, and freed him from his burden. With that, the child left the cradle behind and they became more than a Tenno, they became themselves.

Tenno, if you can find a way to forgive this old man’s deception, to trust him again, then he will forever be in your service.

Teshin Dax
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyZh:
在冰封的山顶，冻僵又受伤的孩子遇到了一位老人——一位被毒誓束缚的囚徒。对孩子来说，冻死也许是一个平和安详的终局。然而他不懈抗争，发现了存于自身的火种，发现了点亮前路的光芒。

这位老人曾是背叛者。他应该受到死亡的惩罚，但孩子聪慧而且仁慈，将他从重负中解脱。从此之后，孩子离开了摇篮，他成为了比 Tenno 更强的存在，他成为了他自己。

Tenno，如果你能够宽恕这位老人的欺骗，能够再次信任他，那么他也将毕生效命于你。

Teshin 禁卫

messageToSendWhenTriggered.titleZh: 伏击的好机会，发动航道星舰。
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyEn:
Crew,

Corpus Convoy moving toward Voidspace redzone. Shipping lanes long abandoned. Void storms. Anomalies. Temporal ghosting.

Remember Lucretia Platform. The final disastrous result of incursion into that place. We are not wanted there. Yet the Corpus return.

It would be stupid to investigate.

Saddle up. We are about to do something stupid.

-Cephalon Cy
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyZh:
舰员们，

Corpus 舰队正在驶向虚空危险区域。航道早已被废弃。虚空风暴。异常现象。时空幽灵。

别忘了卢克丽霞平台发生的事。侵入那个地方而最终导致的灾难性后果。我们在那不受欢迎。然而，Corpus 还是回来了。

如果去进行调查那就太蠢了。

准备出发吧。我们马上就要去做一件蠢事了。

-中枢赛伊

messageToSendWhenTriggered.title: /Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/GrandmotherInboxTitle
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyEn:
Oh, hello dear. What a pity that all Nef Anyo's money could not buy him a morsel of taste nor a crumb of conscience. A man with the morals of a creeping scab, and just between the two of us, not a patch on the man his father was. One hates to do business of any kind with his sort, but you must understand, dear, that an old friend's life was at stake.
Imagine failing to recognise the beauty of Waverider 1! Thinking of it as low, commoner art, seeing it only as a source of cash! What do you suppose he might have said if he'd known that there was something quite unexpected concealed in those pages? Well. More someone than something, if I'm being honest with you.

This is for you, Tenno. The very, very old friend of mine I mentioned before, finally located. Bring her to life, if you'd be so kind? I think my young ‘tenants' on Fortuna would like to meet her.
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyZh:
哦，你好，亲爱的。多么遗憾的是，奈富·安尤的全副身家都不能为他买来一丁点品味，也买不来一丁点良心。一个毫无道德底线的人，而且就在我们俩之间，丝毫没有他父亲的影子。人们讨厌与他这类人进行任何形式的交易，但你必须明白，亲爱的，有一位老朋友已经危在旦夕。

想象一下未能体会到《驭浪者 #1》的美妙之处！认为它是底层平民的艺术品，只是把它看成一件可以换到钱的物品！如果他知道那几页中潜藏着某件出人意料的东西，你猜他会说什么？好吧。老实说，与其说那是某件东西，倒不如说是某个人。

Tenno，这是给你的。那个我先前提到的非常非常老的朋友，终于找到了。如果你是个好人的话，那就让她重获新生吧？我想我在福尔图娜的年轻“房客”会想见见她的。

messageToSendWhenTriggered.title: /Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/ExtraRewardsSubject
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyEn:
Oh, curse this addled memory of mine. It seems that you and my dear Yareli are already known to one another.

So, in honor of mutual friendship and adventures to come, a small additional reward for you.

Mind how you go!

Grandmother
messageToSendWhenTriggered.bodyZh:
哦，我这该死的混乱记忆。看来你和我亲爱的 Yareli 已经互相认识了。

所以，为了纪念彼此的友谊和即将到来的冒险，这是一点给你的额外奖励。

路上小心！

"祖母"
